standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T145119Z; numbers.json recomputed 2026-11-03T02:42Z (UTC) after the 2026-11-02 fix to tools/issue.py (commit ead9e9c), which pairs the Choice cutout less dressed fed cattle difference with the report 2700 row dated 1 to 4 days after the cutout week: cutout week ending 2026-10-09 (376.20) against the report dated Tuesday 2026-10-13, week ending Sunday 2026-10-11 (358.22), 17.98, a week older than the cutout headline (2026-10-16). The BLS PPI, CPI and average-price series carry September 2026. Prose drafted 2026-11-02 by a session from numbers.md, then revised on an independent review that recalculated every headline figure from the captured reports, including the pairing and every weekday (all matched), and required these changes: the lead no longer says 'wholesale beef values' are higher, because the beef primal and subprimal cuts PPI is 2.3% lower; the cutout's rise on the year is stated as recent and reflecting last year's level (in the captures the Choice cutout was below its year-earlier week every week from 2026-08-07 to 2026-09-18 and averaged 376.85 in September 2026 against 396.10 in September 2025; neither figure is in the computed set, so the issue says only that its computed set compares the latest four weeks); the claim about the pork cutout is attributed to Pork Monitor Issue 1 rather than resting on pork captures absent from evidence.json; and methodology.md's series-break date is corrected (the single 600-900 column begins 2004-01-09 and the 600-750 column ends 2004-12-30; the page had said roughly 2015) and its 'pound carcass' wording dropped. Clarifications applied: the report's year-ago change (-11.15) attributed to the Datamart JSON, since no PDF of the 2026-10-13 report is retained; the report 2700 date described as normally the publication date (rows dated 2026-05-26 and 2026-09-08 published a day later; every row before 2026-03-31, including the 2025 rows used here, carries a Datamart load date of 2026-03-24, so first-print status is unknown); FOB plant attributed to the cuts section; 'branded' dropped from the issue and marked as the record's reading in the methodology; the cutout-less-cattle difference stated as labelled per hundredweight in this record; 'every cattle price' made 'every cattle measure' (the slaughter cattle PPI is an index); NASS revision wording quoted as 'subject to revision'; the 'cattle and calves on feed' wording attributed to the release's opening sentence; methodology's 'selling basis' made 'purchasing basis', the 2026-10-31 PDF identified as the report of 2026-10-27, and the Cattle and Beef Summary's description matched to the retained file. tools/check.py passes. The verification gate reads no bare count or worded quantity: six kinds of measure, both four-report averages, 255,344 head (245,013 + 10,331), 16 States, sixty-five percent, 'lowest for August since the series began in 1996' (both placements and marketings), 'every monthly beef measure with a two-year comparison' (five measures, smallest +16.6%), 'a week older' (seven days) and 'within four days' were checked by hand against the captures. This is the first issue of this title; its September 2026 baseline does not publish (owner decision 2026-10-25). Known limits stated in the text: the cutout-less-cattle difference has no prior-year figure and pairs a week older than the cutout headline; the cutout is Choice only and negotiated sales delivered within 0-21 days, the cattle price all grades and negotiated, formula, contract and grid purchases; report 2700 prints dollars with no weight basis and the per-cwt label comes from the source list; the report 2700 coverage wording is quoted from the report of 2026-10-27 (run 2026-10-31T013744Z, in evidence.json with role specification); fed cattle dates are publication dates; the pork cutout is comprehensive and runs a week behind. For the editor: the NASS Cattle on Feed release of 2026-10-23 (retained in runs 2026-10-23T220748Z and 2026-10-31T013744Z) revises the September 1 inventory to 11,168, August placements to 1,620 and August marketings to 1,517; the issue stays on its own run and says newer releases exist without quoting them. bls/series.json marks October 2025 'Data unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations' for CUUR0000SEFC, CUUR0000SEFV, APU0000FC1101 and APU0000FC3101, so the November beef issue will have no year-earlier value for those four rows. beef/sources.json still says 'roughly 2015', 'packer margins' and 'cattle and cutout moving apart is the packer's margin' in its descriptions; not changed here. _cutout_cattle_pair would skip a holiday cutout week ending on a Thursday (gap of 5 days). The next-issue date, November 13, 2026, matches the pork and cheddar issues and is not in any capture. Publication is gated only by FA-D-20261018-01: one title at a time, through the review step, after Chicken Monitor.
